approach: Add athena_gate::attribution::check_attribution(git, main_tip, now: jiff::Timestamp). It reads only athena/records: landing-intents/ and landings/ via ls_tree_under plus cat_blobs, parsed with HistoryRecord::parse. It also audits the records branch's own history with a new helper in athena-git records_branch.rs. It walks rev-list --first-parent --parents from the earliest intent's expected_base (the base itself is judged). A commit is attributed if a landing names it as host_commit and the intent that landing cites matches (tree, first parent) via LandingIntent::matches. Otherwise it is pending if a matching intent exists and now is within 15 minutes of created_at; else it is a finding (stale intent or unattributed). Missing ref, no intent, or a base off main's line is a finding. The CLI adds check --attribution (conflicts with --history and --pr-head), prints text or JSON, exits 2 on a finding. CI gets a non-blocking attribution job that fetches athena/records first. The producer re-reads records-history.md sections 5.2, 6, 10 and D111 first and adjusts the non-fast-forward definition if the doc differs.

decisions.choice: Take the check time as a jiff::Timestamp argument; the CLI passes Timestamp::now().
decisions.reason: Tests pin the 15-minute window without sleeping.

rejected.option: Read the clock inside the check
rejected.why: Tests could not pin the window and would be flaky.

decisions.choice: Judge head tree and expected base through the intent the landing cites, using LandingIntent::matches(tree, parent).
decisions.reason: The Landing has no tree field; the intent holds head_tree_sha and expected_base. One definition is shared with reconcile.

rejected.why: Those are the PR's commits, not the announced head tree, and the expected base would go unchecked.

decisions.choice: Read local refs/heads/athena/records first, then refs/remotes/origin/athena/records; report a finding if both exist and neither is an ancestor of the other.
decisions.reason: CI fetch creates the local ref; a developer checkout may only have the remote-tracking one. Divergence signals a rewritten remote.

rejected.why: Contradicts the fetch into athena/records in CI.

decisions.choice: Add records_branch::audit_history(git, tip): walk the first-parent chain; report a second root or a wrong root, and any commit whose tree drops or changes a file its first parent held. Extra parents are allowed.
decisions.reason: A snapshot cannot show a past force-push but shows a rewritten history by these symptoms. Landing commits legitimately carry extra parents.

rejected.option: Require exactly one parent per commit
rejected.why: Landing commits have a second parent (append_to_remote extra_parents).

decisions.choice: Use main tip HEAD as check --history does, and judge the base commit itself.
decisions.reason: CI checks out the pushed sha. The request says walk from the base onward.

rejected.option: Skip the base like reconcile (start = base+1)
rejected.why: The base is the first commit in scope.

decisions.choice: No commit-trailer parsing and no host calls.

rejected.option: Reuse Change::trailers or reconcile's host fallback

files.purpose: check_attribution, AttributionReport, Finding; doc comments citing records-history.md 5.2, 6, 10, D111; unit tests.
Ref reader (local, else remote-tracking, divergence) and audit_history, with tests.
Only if needed: share a first-parent listing helper; otherwise untouched.
--attribution flag, conflicts, dispatch, exit 2 on finding, help text.
attribution_report renderer (text and JSON) naming each bad commit.
Tests for help listing, flag conflicts, no-records exit.
Governance deliverable: non-blocking attribution job beside history.
Entry for athena check --attribution in the file's existing format.

steps: Read records-history.md sections 5.2, 6, 10 and D111 and confirm the 15-minute rule and non-fast-forward wording.
In records_branch.rs add the ref reader and audit_history with unit tests.

Create attribution.rs: load intents and landings, parse with HistoryRecord::parse (parse failure is a finding), pick the earliest intent by (created_at, id), walk first-parent from its expected_base, apply attributed/pending/stale/unattributed rules.
Add unit tests: pass, unrecorded, pending at +14/+15/+16m, mismatching intent, pre-base ignored, no ref, no intent, non-ff records history.
Add the CLI flag, dispatch and display renderer.
Add the attribution job to ci.yml.
Run cargo fmt --all, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: The ci.yml job cannot be run here; an error in its if or fetch step shows only in CI.
risks.mitigation: Copy the structure and SHA pins of the existing history job; mark continue-on-error.

risks.risk: On the first run athena/records may not exist on origin, so the fetch fails.
risks.mitigation: Job is non-blocking; the command reports a missing ref as an explicit finding.

risks.risk: A landing may cite a missing or mismatched intent, or two intents may match one commit.
risks.mitigation: Treat as a finding; unit test it.

risks.risk: Intent created_at in the future relative to now.
risks.mitigation: Treat as pending; test the +15m boundary.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in attribution.rs: temp repo with base and squash commit; write intent (expected_base=base, head_tree=squash tree) and landing (host_commit=squash, intent=id) with RecordsWriter; run check just after the landing.
demonstrations.observes: Report has no findings and the squash is counted attributed.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the match logic is missing or compares tree/base wrongly, the squash is flagged and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: Unit test: add a main commit with no intent and no landing; run the check.
demonstrations.observes: Report fails with an Unattributed finding containing the commit's full sha; rendered text names it.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the unattributed rule the commit passes silently and the finding assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Unit test: commit with matching intent and no landing; run at created_at+14m, +15m and +16m.
demonstrations.observes: At +14m and +15m no findings and the commit is pending; at +16m a finding names the commit and expired intent.
demonstrations.fails_without: No pending window fails the +14m case; no expiry passes the +16m case and fails the test.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests in attribution.rs and records_branch.rs: build a records history with a second-root commit and another dropping a prior file; also a normal branch with an extra-parent commit.
demonstrations.observes: Report has a records-history finding naming the offending records commit; the normal branch has none.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the audit the rewritten history yields no finding and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: Binary tests run the real binary: check --help; check --attribution --history; check --attribution --pr-head a b; --attribution in a repo without athena/records.
demonstrations.observes: Help lists --attribution; via cargo test -p athena-cli --test binary the combinations exit non-zero with a clap conflict message, and the no-records case exits 2 with a finding.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without conflicts_with the combinations are accepted and the test fails; without the flag the help assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the diff for doc comments citing records-history.md 5.2, 6, 10 and D111, no trailer/log_grep/Change::trailers use in attribution.rs, and the pre-base test.
demonstrations.observes: Doc comments present, no trailer calls; the pre-base unrecorded commit test passes with no finding for it (cargo test -p athena-gate attribution).
demonstrations.fails_without: If the walk started before the base, the pre-base test would report that commit and fail.

demonstrations.observes: attribution job beside history: continue-on-error true; if push to main or schedule; checkout fetch-depth 0; step git fetch origin athena/records:athena/records before athena check --attribution; actions pinned by the same 40-hex SHAs; comment says not required.
demonstrations.fails_without: Missing fetch or wrong if condition would be absent in the diff, so the review fails.

demonstrations.method: Run the workspace gates; each must exit 0. The new tests, the clippy -D warnings gate and fmt would fail on any formatting, lint or test regression introduced by the change (e.g. a failing attribution test, an unused import, unformatted code).
demonstrations.observes: No warnings; then cargo fmt --all --check shows no diff and cargo test --locked passes across the workspace, including the new attribution and binary tests.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the attribution logic were wrong or the code unformatted or lint-dirty, cargo test, fmt --check or clippy would exit non-zero.
